texts.orig: Figure 3b shows that doses among the various body structures are inhomogeneous. Specifically; the left side of the tumor surface receives higher doses compared to its right side, and there is a noticeable difference in the amount of radiation received by the boundary voxels on the left and right side of the nose. Further, the skin tissues exhibit long tails in their DVHs and most voxels on the left side of the tumor are exposed to a high dose.
